verdict.rationale: BILL documents budgets, virtual cards, and 'custom approval policies' plus AI-powered spend controls marketed as making transactions 'automatically compliant,' which supports policy-based limits and approval routing. However, there is no concrete evidence detailing configuration by category, role, and context together, nor explicit description of an auto-approve-in-policy/exception-escalation workflow. Missing for 10: granular category/role/context policy configuration details, explicit auto-approval vs. exception-routing logic, and independent confirmation of this behavior in practice.
